objective: Test whether the HookLab evidence-to-creative workflow, listening interface and producer evaluation capture useful creative information before confirmatory H/D/H+D testing.

conditions.label: Humana
conditions.definition: Melodic proposal made without HookLab deduction guidance.

conditions.label: Deducción experimental
conditions.definition: Melodic proposal constrained by documented exploratory parameters. D0 is not a scientifically promoted success rule.

conditions.label: Humana + datos
conditions.definition: Producer revision after inspecting the D0 rationale and evidence boundaries.

controlled_material.text: Vuelvo a encontrar la luz / cuando tu voz vuelve a mí / queda latiendo el lugar / donde te quiero sentir

blinding: Condition labels should be hidden during first listening when technically possible.
boundary: P0 evaluates workflow/usability and creative response. It cannot validate a causal or predictive success claim and cannot promote D0 into a HookLab rule.
